verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a cloud data warehouse with AI features such as Dives and a remote MCP server, so a no-training data policy or opt-out is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used for AI model training, and there is no documented opt-out. Adjacent controls like SaaS Mode (which limits local environment access), read-only MCP access and user-scoped secrets are different capabilities and earn no credit here.
